name: HTW Berlin: Weighted Average Grade (for CE)
description: Reads values in grade overview and corresponding credit points of this module. Based on calculations found in study regulations the weighted average   is created. This extension is only valid for Computer Engineering (maybe FB1 but not sure). The regulations state that none of the modules of first semester are counted the grade of the internship also does not count. The user has the option to click the extension icon where the weighted average is shown. By choice the user can also enter a desired bachelor grade and colloquium grade. The these are used to calculate the final grade.
